name: q-note
description: A compact native desktop note app built with Longbridge Native Shell and Rust.

scripts.test: pnpm build:ui && cargo test --workspace --locked && node --test tests/tooling.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:ui && pnpm format:check && cargo check --workspace --locked
scripts.format: prettier --write ui scripts tests/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/*.yml && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check ui scripts tests/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/*.yml && cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.release: bumpp package.json Cargo.toml ui/nsh.json --git-check --all --execute "node scripts/sync-cargo-lock.mjs" --commit "release: v%s" --tag "v%s" --push
